title: 43% Of The Walking Gap Comes From Gender
hook: Gender explains 43% of the world's walking inequality.
closing: Health improves when cities make everyday walking practical for everyone, not merely the already active.
question: How walkable is your neighborhood?

segments.say: Hong Kong averages 6,880 daily steps. Where people live can shape movement before motivation enters the picture.
High-inequality countries score 297 on obesity likelihood. Unequal movement tracks a much larger health burden.
Gender explains 43 percent of activity inequality. Women walking less drives nearly half the global gap.
